description:
## TrialHarvest-AI workflow description

TrialHarvest-AI is a multi-phase workflow that extracts structured data from scientific 
literature on Long Term Experiments (LTEs). The main phases of the workflow are:
1. Convert scientific-literature PDFs into structured markdown.
2. Run schema-driven LLM extraction over the markdown.
3. Validate extracted JSON through type, semantic, and AGROVOC checks.
4. Assess extraction quality and generate figures.

This is an abstract workflow description, that serves as a documentation of the overall workflow structure. It is a first step towards a fully executable workflow.
name: UC4 - TrialHarvest-AI
tools: apply logical domain-specific validation rules to typed extraction outputs.
build schema-aware prompt bundles for the extraction agent.
compute agreement statistics such as fleiss' kappa and jaccard overlaps.
detect documents that contain multiple lte descriptions and pass filtered pdfs downstream.
generate figures from quality scores and consensus metrics.
parse filtered pdfs and emit structured markdown intermediates.
resolve agrovoc concept uris and produce fair json data.
run llm extraction on structured markdown using the generated schema prompt bundle.
score extraction quality over the validated json outputs.
validate extracted json against typed models and normalize unit or coordinate values.
